records.body_text:
Dear Samhita Deshpande  ,

This mail is regarding the invigilation process for the upcoming BTTS-17 on 12th march 2025 (02:30 pm to 05:30 pm). Please find the details to join the invigilation meeting
below.

BTTS 17: (2:30 pm to 5:30 pm)
Meeting Link: https://us06web.zoom.us/j/82544348353?pwd=LpitSEKhNUW4O030XmWnUFam8lSFZ0.1

Meeting ID: 825 4434 8353

Meeting Passcode:789

Moderator Name: Sarang sir

Moderator Number:8378987764

Online Test Platform

The Test will be allocated to you on BT’s online test platform whose details are given below.

Online Test Platform Link: https://exams.bakliwaltutorialsiit.com/

Please use the above credentials and follow these guidelines:

→ You should join the Zoom meeting, turn on your camera, and then open the online test platform and start writing the test. In case, you are giving the exam from a device whose camera turns off when minimised, then it is mandatory for you that student to log into zoom invigilation from a different device. The entire Zoom invigilation shall be recorded for BT’s review.

→ We would like to remind you that with the new proctoring tool in place, you should not switch back to the zoom window once the test begins. In case you feel that you have any doubts/queries about any question in the BTest, leave the question and proceed to the next one. Do not try to chat with the invigilator on zoom in such a case.

→ In case you want to contact the invigilator in case of emergency, please call the invigilator in front of one of your parents/guardians using their phone. The contact details of the invigilator are provided to you above.

→ With this new proctoring tool, it is now no longer necessary for the parents to be physically present to invigilate you during the BTest. They should just ensure that you do not have any mobile phones or other similar devices/books near you during the BTest.

→ Please switch off all the notifications on the computer on which you will give the test.

records.body_text:
Hey Venkatesh,

There’s always something going on over at Real Python as far as Python tutorials go.

Here’s what you may have missed this past week:

Quiz: What Is the Python Global Interpreter Lock (GIL)? ( https://realpython.com/quizzes/python-gil/ )

In this quiz, you'll test your understanding of the Python Global Interpreter Lock (GIL). The GIL behaves like a mutex that allows only one thread to hold the control of the Python interpreter. This has advantages, but can be a performance bottleneck in CPU-bound and multi-threaded code:

→ realpython.com/quizzes/python-gil ( https://realpython.com/quizzes/python-gil/ )

Python while Loops: Repeating Tasks Conditionally ( https://realpython.com/python-while-loop/ )

In this tutorial, you'll learn about indefinite iteration using the Python while loop. You'll be able to construct basic and complex while loops, interrupt loop execution with break and continue, use the else clause with a while loop, and deal with infinite loops:

→ realpython.com/python-while-loop ( https://realpython.com/python-while-loop/ )

Python Error and Performance Monitoring That Doesn’t Suck ( https://realpython.com/newsletter/link/43a62c03-6a8e-46e8-89ba-67a5608a46f6 )

Sponsored by Sentry

( https://realpython.com/newsletter/link/43a62c03-6a8e-46e8-89ba-67a5608a46f6 )
With Sentry, you can trace issues from the frontend to the backend—detecting slow and broken code, to fix what’s broken faster. Installing the Python SDK is super easy and Real Python's subscribers get 150,000 errors free.

→ Just Use Code “realpython” on Signup ( https://realpython.com/newsletter/link/43a62c03-6a8e-46e8-89ba-67a5608a46f6 )

Working With Python Polars ( https://realpython.com/courses/working-with-python-polars/ )

Question: Why are most Telugu people non-vegetarian in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana?

Introducing Poe Apps
records.body_text:
Hi everyone,

Over the last two years, we have built Poe as a unified chat interface to all AI. We now provide millions of users with access to 100 of the best text, image, video, and audio models from leading AI companies, along with millions of bots built on top of them, all in one place.

We have learned from this experience that while chat is the right interface for many people and for many use cases, there are also many cases where a visual UI is a better interface, particularly when a single workflow involves the use of multiple models made by different companies — access that Poe can uniquely provide.

Today we are introducing Poe Apps, which make it easy to build visual interfaces on top of any combination of the existing models on Poe and custom logic expressed in JavaScript. Poe Apps can run side-by-side with chat, or be entirely visual. Thanks to the integration with Poe, when these apps need to make potentially-expensive model calls, they will use the user's existing points, so that as a creator, you don't have to risk ending up with huge API bills, or having downtime when your app hits limits.

You can create a Poe App without writing any code, thanks to App Creator (https://poe.com/App-Creator), which we built on top of Claude 3.7 Sonnet. Or, if vibe coding is not for you, you can take full control of the underlying HTML and JavaScript. Either way, we'll be giving distribution to the best apps within Poe through the existing systems we have built out for bots. This means our millions of users are all your potential audience, with no extra work required on your part.

records.subject: Upcoming changes to your settings
records.body_text:
Hi Venkatesh,


We're piloting changes to Google Play purchase verification to give you new  
controls over your purchase experience.


Play purchase verification helps prevent unauthorised purchases on your  
device. Currently, you can choose to require Play purchase verification  
always, every 30 minutes or never. However, some payment methods include  
their own, separate verification process. For those payment methods, you  
currently have to complete verification twice if you also have Play  
verification turned on.


Soon, this setting will change so that you can choose whether to require  
Play verification for payment methods that already include a separate  
verification process. In particular, this change will affect payments made  
through UPI and netbanking, because they have their own verification  
processes (e.g. PIN-based verification on UPI).


*Important:* This update may affect settings that you have previously  
chosen. To check your current settings in the Google Play app, tap the  
profile icon at the top right > Settings > Purchase verification.


This update will impact your current setting choice as described below. You  
can always choose to change your settings, including requiring Play  
verification for all purchases, once these updates are available.

records.subject: [KodeKloud - DevOps Learning Community] Summary
records.body_text:
A brief summary of [KodeKloud - DevOps Learning Community][1] since your last visit on November 18, 2024

29 New Topics
1 Unread Notifications
287 New Users

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Popular Topics

[Can someone please guide me on how to proceed with DevOps and cloud career][2]

 We can work as DevOps without deep cloud knowledge, but these days, the IT industry, especially DevOps, is highly competitive. Most companies only have 1-3 DevOps engineers, and only large companies have dedicated infrastructure teams. This means we often need broad knowledge to secure a job. In my opinion, you might want to consider starting as a Cloud Engineer to gain experience before transitioning to a DevOps role.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[Level 4 Docker - Resolve Dockerfile Issues][3]

 Yes, you can use the Feedback button, which lets you take a screenshot and send it to the team.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[CreateContainerConfigError after K8s upgrade to version 1.31][4]

 Hi! After upgrading the first ControlPlane server to K8s version 1.31 and rebooting it, all its pods originated from daemonsets are in the “CreateContainerConfigError” state, instead of the “Running” state. The error message shown in them, as well as in the kubelet service, is: “Error: services have not yet been read at least once, cannot construct envvars”. I’ve never gone through this kind of trouble in previous K8s version upgrades, since 1.27. Does anyone know the reason and the fix for this? Thank you!
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[Argocd CLI not able to access][5]

records.subject: Bakliwal Tutorials : Details for Round 2 of Revision
records.body_text:
Dear Samhita Deshpande,

Hope you are all geared up to attempt the JEE Main Session 1 soon. We wish you all the best and hope that you perform up to your maximum potential in the exam.

After your JEE Main Session 1, we have planned another round of exhaustive revision and test series to complement the revision. We at BT strongly believe that the last few months of your preparation are the most crucial ones and hence even after the syllabus is complete we strongly recommend that you must continue to attend the lectures at BT and the systematic revision that will take place will immensely benefit you.

Revision Round 2 Plan

The second round of revision will be conducted from 3 Feb 2025 to 30 Mar 2025. In this 8 week interval, every 2 weeks, 4 Physics, 4 Maths and 5 Chemistry lectures will be conducted. The lecture plan for each of these lectures is attached in the pdf below.

Test Series

As before, JEE Advanced and JEE Mains pattern tests will also be conducted in this period on every Wednesday and on some Saturdays as well. Apart from this, mock BITSAT and mock MHT CET will also be conducted. Along with these regular tests, a large number of practice tests will also be uploaded to BT’s online test portal for you to practice in your own time. The detailed plan of the regular tests is also given in the pdf attached below.

We shall also be conducting Mock Board Exams for you for Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics subjects from 7th Feb to 9th Feb. The details of the same will be mentioned in the next timetable.

In case you have any queries regarding this, please write to us at academics@bakliwaltutorialsiit.com and we’ll get them resolved.

Regards,

BT Team.

records.body_text:

This collaboration will provide a more focused and productive learning environment.

You can join the Telegram channel by clicking the below link to attend the online lectures till February 1st.

Telegram link: https://t.me/+eGYHjfJjOVY4ZTll

Thank you for your understanding, and let’s make the most of this revision week together!

Best regards,

BT Team

[Clarification on Draining Nodes During Kubernetes Upgrade Using kubeadm][2]

 An upgrade should work whether or not the nodes are drained. The idea behind draining nodes and why it is good practice is to prevent application downtime in production clusters. What drain does is 

Make the node unschedulable so no new pods get placed on it (cordon)
Evict existing pods (effectively kubectl delete), so that they return to scheduling to be recreated on another node.

If there are no nodes that can accept the pod (perhaps due to taints) then it remains in Pending state, which means it is still with the scheduler until a suitable node becomes available. When the node is uncordoned after upgrade, pending pods will be created on it. 
In a production cluster, all your deployments should have at least 2 replicas, and there should be enough nodes that are valid for the pods being rescheduled. Whilst a pod is being rescheduled, other replicas of the deployment are still alive to handle traffic and prevent service interruption.

records.subject: Bakliwal Tutorials : Details for Round 2 of Revision
records.body_text:
Dear Samhita Deshpande,

Hope you are all geared up to attempt the JEE Main Session 1 soon. We wish you all the best and hope that you perform up to your maximum potential in the exam.

After your JEE Main Session 1, we have planned another round of exhaustive revision and test series to complement the revision. We at BT strongly believe that the last few months of your preparation are the most crucial ones and hence even after the syllabus is complete we strongly recommend that you must continue to attend the lectures at BT and the systematic revision that will take place will immensely benefit you.

Revision Round 2 Plan

The second round of revision will be conducted from 3 Feb 2025 to 30 Mar 2025. In this 8 week interval, every 2 weeks, 4 Physics, 4 Maths and 5 Chemistry lectures will be conducted. The lecture plan for each of these lectures is attached in the pdf below.

Test Series

As before, JEE Advanced and JEE Mains pattern tests will also be conducted in this period on every Wednesday and on some Saturdays as well. Apart from this, mock BITSAT and mock MHT CET will also be conducted. Along with these regular tests, a large number of practice tests will also be uploaded to BT’s online test portal for you to practice in your own time. The detailed plan of the regular tests is also given in the pdf attached below.

We shall also be conducting Mock Board Exams for you for Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics subjects from 7th Feb to 9th Feb. The details of the same will be mentioned in the next timetable.

In case you have any queries regarding this, please write to us at academics@bakliwaltutorialsiit.com and we’ll get them resolved.

Regards,

BT Team.

records.subject: Discontinuation of the SpaceCode Private Preview
records.body_text:
Dear customers,

Today we are announcing the discontinuation of the SpaceCode Private Preview, which we launched in May 2024. 

On May 27, 2024, we announced <https://go.jetbrains.com/dc/-icI2tQf6NVMNO5rORnaba5ESc_fwfNr1uq20ixDodsy-cnKbmn8EzonHXqnGFOc00aPB1c_2QTbkr-QOCqGY_NZ6l0MDh599LjjR1a265ej7N7DiP9jkpOrR-zEJCNV6dbMS5ubKHsgo4YgI6e_Yy7N8eHUgjRdnbI4XuMEAgMyMjtJZxbHrJ-Kk1ZsMwIB/NDI2LVFWRC0xMTQAAAGXDBF-4AcMMEENJmsfosTmaHsWxKJmNkkJ9fq60vFb4klu0NmhBGlxZuR_aMglZXvZX2r_MR4=> that we had decided to discontinue Space and pivot it to a new product: SpaceCode. The plan was for SpaceCode to focus primarily on Git hosting and code reviews. For the last six months, we’ve been collecting feedback from SpaceCode users and polishing the product to make the user experience more enjoyable. In light of user feedback and current market trends, we’ve decided not to make SpaceCode generally available.
How this affects you as a Space and SpaceCode customer


	- Cloud customers (with Free, Monthly, and Yearly subscriptions) can use SpaceCode together with Space for free until May 31, 2025. Starting on June 1, 2025, access to SpaceCode and Space Cloud organizations will be disabled. Check our migration guide <https://go.jetbrains.com/dc/k2oLQLl4sOXaMfj4PBQzO5ObQfNkw5Z7U2DIa1YX26hDgJaeWUBFxIPZ3Mr-oHnDmxJY7_BGdDbFYXpFk4SEZXJ8xQ6LODFd72xJa48kKe5UZnZcNdA1iLO9I-JrK-2kJ36MjdO6L3lpJyqd79h3_EkGruPcn5rj6X9R6OlNzeIBuQ-DfNjGid44QiON6IyvOdmZydIqcVWSO8EPTN8-6JqyqaKqClPqcok7AQw_BZQ=/NDI2LVFWRC0xMTQAAAGXDBF-4AcMMEENJmsfosTmaHsWxKJmNkkJ9fq60vFb4klu0NmhBGlxZuR_aMglZXvZX2r_MR4=> to learn more about how to migrate all your data to alternative software.




	- On-premises customers will be able to use Space and SpaceCode for an indefinite period of time and extended user numbers. Please check the updated Space Terms of Service here <https://go.jetbrains.com/dc/k2oLQLl4sOXaMfj4PBQzOx6urbYco0fGlgFR-ykKgaVGsefzfJePhcqcJMOPvCc-3OnVmkPYv6OJgu_gxktNlmSwfNrUNiASf1B1orbjPpPK0oKJKgY6WuQAbaMNxWMkPAEBJf9lSxF

Reminder: Migrate your Vagrant Cloud account today
records.body_text:
Hello,

In May we announced[1] we announced that Vagrant Cloud[2] is moving to
the HashiCorp Cloud Platform[3] (HCP) under the new name of HCP Vagrant
Registry. To avoid service interruption, migrate your organization to
HCP[4] by October 4.

Creating an HCP account is free and comes with major benefits for
Vagrant users, including:

  * Better box discovery
  * Free hosting for public and private boxes
  * Access to all HCP products with the $50 free trial credit[5]

Note: Any boxes that have not been migrated will be automatically
moved from Vagrant Cloud to HCP Vagrant Registry after October 18.
During migration, your organization will be under maintenance and you
won’t be able to access it until the automated migration is completed.

How automated migration works

  * At the start of automated migration, you’ll receive an email
    notification to the address associated with your Vagrant Cloud
    organization.

    - Please contact our support team if you no longer have access to
      the original email address: support+vagrantcloud@hashicorp.com

  * An email confirmation will be sent once the migration is complete.
  * After automatic migration, you will need to claim your HCP Vagrant
    Registry. To do this you’ll need to:

    * Create an HCP account[6] using the same email address that was
      associated with your original Vagrant Cloud account
    * Link[7] the new HCP account to the Vagrant Cloud account
    * Validate[8] you are the owner and claim your boxes

Note: If you don’t set up a new HCP account and claim your boxes, you
will lose access to Vagrant Cloud after November 25, 2024.

Vagrant remains an easy-to-use tool for building complete development
environments and we’re excited for the improvements its new home on HCP
will bring. If you have any questions, don’t hesitate to reach out to us
at vagrant@hashicorp.com.

- The Vagrant Team

records.subject: 🐍 New Python tutorials on Real Python
records.body_text:
Hey Venkatesh,

There’s always something going on over at Real Python as far as Python tutorials go.

Here’s what you may have missed this past week:

Python Virtual Environments: A Primer ( https://realpython.com/python-virtual-environments-a-primer/ )

In this tutorial, you'll learn how to use a Python virtual environment to manage your Python projects. You'll also gain a deep understanding of the structure of virtual environments created with the venv module, as well as the rationale behind using virtual environments:

→ realpython.com/python-virtual-environments-a-primer ( https://realpython.com/python-virtual-environments-a-primer/ )

Advanced Python import Techniques ( https://realpython.com/courses/advanced-import-techniques/ )

The Python import system is as powerful as it is useful. In this in-depth video course, you'll learn how to harness this power to improve the structure and maintainability of your code:

records.subject: Improve Code Coverage in High-Risk Areas
records.body_text:
New Code Coverage metrics for improving coverage in high-risk areas 
 ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌  ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ 


IMPROVE CODE COVERAGE IN HIGH-RISK AREAS 

 		 [1] 

It's crucial to recognize that Code Coverage metrics can sometimes be
deceptive or manipulated. A high coverage score, like 80%, doesn't
necessarily indicate that the most problematic areas or frequently
modified files are adequately covered.  

AND WHAT ABOUT THOSE TRICKY LEGACY FILES WITH COMPLEX CODE THAT YOU'D
PREFER TO AVOID?

CodeScene's Code Coverage feature offers more than standard code
coverage analysis. It combines coverage metrics to identify and
mitigate high-risk areas by integrating with CodeScene analytics and
metrics. Plus, it evaluates the sufficiency of coverage for planned
refactoring efforts.
 [2] [2]Learn more about CodeScene’s Code Coverage feature [1] 

 		 Get started for free [1] 

IMPROVE CODE COVERAGE IN HIGH-RISK AREAS

Hotspots are the most frequently changed areas of your codebase, often
with technical debt carrying the highest vulnerability for bugs. Our
new KPI, Hotspot Code Coverage helps you focus on improving Code
Coverage where it truly matters - in the high risk areas. 

 		 [1] 

	* MITIGATE RISKS

Identify feature areas with low coverage before planning refactoring
tasks.

	* DETECT DEEPER ISSUES

Combine your views to identify hotspots that have low code coverage,
low Code Health, and many defects.

	* EXPLORE ORGANIZATIONAL OR PROJECT LEVEL

Quickly see if a project has decreased in code coverage and, if so,
find out why and how to address it. 

 		 Learn more [1]

records.body_text:
‘Digital Arrest Scam’ is a form of impersonation scam where the fraudster impersonates a law enforcement official and blames the victim regarding his/ her involvement in crimes such as drug trafficking, money laundering, terror financing etc. and coerces the victim to agree to an online interrogation.How does a ‘Digital Arrest Scam’ work? * The fraudster gathers basic information about the victim, then impersonates a law enforcement official and contacts the victim via a phone call/ video call.
 * The impostor shows fabricated evidence which implicates the victim of being involved in illegal activities such as drug trafficking, money laundering, terror financing etc.
 * The victim is then forced to stay on a video call for a day long interrogation threating with an arrest if he/ she fails to comply (such an act is referred to as a ‘digital arrest’).
 * The victim is then told that in order to clear their name of all charges, they will have to transfer all funds from all of their savings bank accounts to an account maintained by the investigating agency till conclusion of the investigation.
 * The victim is assured that funds will be credited back to their account in 2 to 3 days on conclusion of investigation. The victim is asked not to disclose any information regarding this conversation/ investigation.
 * The victim, mindlessly transfers the amount so as to prove his/ her innocence.
Precautionary Measures: * Protect your personal and financial information. Never share your sensitive information with unknown individuals or organizations, whether over the Phone, Video call, Social Media Apps, Email etc.
 * Be wary of unsolicited Voice Calls, Video Calls, SMS, E-mails or Messages received through Social Media Apps. Remember, police officers do not interrogate criminals via video call.
 * Beware of unknown callers impersonating bank, police or any other law enforcement officials. To appear genuine, these impostors may use logos of various law enforcement depart

records.body_text:
The following Red Hat Bug Fix Advisory has been published which may affect
subscriptions which you have purchased.


RHBA-2024:4497 Red Hat OpenShift Pipelines Operator Bundle 1.15.1 release


Summary:

Red Hat OpenShift Pipelines 1.15.1 has been released.

Red Hat OpenShift Pipelines is a cloud-native continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) solution for building pipelines using Tekton. Tekton is a flexible, Kubernetes-native, open-source CI/CD framework which enables automating deployments across multiple platforms such as Kubernetes, Serverless, and VMs by abstracting away the underlying details.

Red Hat OpenShift Pipelines consists of:

(Needs to be updated)
- Tekton Operator 0.71.x
- Tekton Pipelines 0.59.x
- Tekton Triggers 0.27.x
- Tekton tkn CLI 0.37.x
- Tekton Chains 0.20.x (GA)
- Pipelines-as-Code 0.27.x (GA)
- ClusterTasks based on Tekton Catalog
- Tekton Hub 1.17.x (TP)
- Tekton Result 0.10.x (TP)
- Manual-Approval-Gate 0.2.x (TP)

## Features

- Standard CI/CD pipelines definition

- Easy to extend and integrate with existing tools

- Portable across any Kubernetes platform

- Designed for microservices and decentralized teams

- Integrated with OpenShift Developer Console

- Build images with Kubernetes tools such as S2I, Buildah, Buildpacks, Kaniko, etc.

- Deploy applications to multiple platforms such as Kubernetes, Serverless, and VMs

- Scale pipelines on-demand

- Enhance supply chain security with Tekton Chains (Technology Preview)

- Install and deploy Tekton Hub (Technology Preview) with custom catalog on enterprise cluster

- Maintain pipelines definitions as parts of an application repository with Pipelines-as-Code (PAC) (General Availability)

For more information, see the Release Notes on any one of the following platforms:

- Customer Portal: https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_openshift_pipelines/1.14/html/about_openshift_pipelines/op-release-notes#op-release-no

records.subject: [Bug Fix Advisory] RHBA-2024:4181 LVMS 4.16 Bug Fix and Enhancement update
records.body_text:
The following Red Hat Bug Fix Advisory has been published which may affect
subscriptions which you have purchased.


RHBA-2024:4181 LVMS 4.16 Bug Fix and Enhancement update


Summary:

Updated container images that add new features and fix multiple bugs are
now available for LVMS 4.16

Logical volume manager storage creates thin-provisioned volumes using the
Logical Volume Manager and provides dynamic provisioning of block storage
on a cluster.

Enhancement(s):

- Support for configuring thick-provisioned storage - This feature provides support for configuring thick-provisioned storage. If you exclude the deviceClasses.thinPoolConfig field in the LVMCluster custom resource (CR), logical volumes are thick provisioned. Thick provisioned volumes do no support volume cloning and VolumeSnapshotClass. Therefore, CSI snapshotting is not supported.

- Support for a new warning message when device selector is not configured in the LVMCluster custom resource - This update provides a new warning message when you do not configure the deviceSelector field in the LVMCluster CR. 

- Support for adding encrypted devices to a volume group - This feature provides support for adding encrypted devices to a volume group. With this release, you can specify the path to the LUKS encrypted device in the deviceSelector field in the LVMCluster CR. 

This erratum corrects the following issues:

- Previously, some LVMVolumeGroupNodeStatus operands were not deleted on the cluster during the deletion of the LVMCluster CR. With this release, deleting the LVMCluster CR triggers the deletion of all the LVMVolumeGroupNodeStatus operands.

- Previously, LVM Storage uninstallation was stuck waiting for the deletion of the LVMVolumeGroupNodeStatus operands. This fix corrects the behavior by ensuring all operands are deleted, allowing LVM Storage to be uninstalled without delay. 

- Previously, LVM Storage created persistent volume claims (PVCs) with storage size requests

records.subject: **IMPORTANT** IDBI Bank - Fraud Awareness | Beware of Impersonation Scam!
records.body_text:
Scammer impersonates a Law Enforcement Official and falsely accuses the victim of being involved in illegal activities, with the intention to defraud him/ her.
			How does an Impersonation Scam work?
				 * The scammer gathers basic information about the victim, he then impersonates a Law Enforcement Officer (eg. Income Tax Official/ TRAI Official/ Electricity Board Official/ Police Officer/ Customs Official etc.) and contacts the victim via phone call/ video call.
				 * The scammer falsely accuses the victim of being involved in illegal activities such as tax evasion, drug trafficking, money laundering etc. and shares some information (Mobile/ Aadhaar Number etc.) as proof.
 * As a part of the investigation and in order to prove his innocence the victim is convinced into temporarily transferring all amount available with him into a bank account maintained by the (fictitious) Law Enforcement Agency, with the assurance that funds will be credited back to his/ her account within 2 to 3 days upon conclusion of the investigation.
				 * The victim is asked not to disclose any information regarding this conversation/ investigation.
 * The victim, mindlessly transfers the amount so as to prove his innocence.
			Precautionary Measures:
				 * Protect your personal and financial information. Never share your sensitive information with unknown persons.
				 * Be wary of unsolicited calls, SMS, emails and WhatsApp messages. Verify the caller's/ sender's identity before clicking on any links or opening attachments.
				 * Beware of unknown callers impersonating bank, police or any other law enforcement officials. Validate the legitimacy of such individuals.
				 * Do not panic and do not act in haste. It is always better to take your time and conduct proper due diligence before making any transaction.
			Report such scam/ fraud cases to national cybercrime helpline. Call 1930 or report on www.cybercrime.gov.in
			IDBI Bank Toll Free Numbers : 1800-209-4324 / 1800

records.body_text:
Dear parents/students, 

 

JEE Advanced 2024 results were declared today. 

 

With your blessings, Bakliwal Tutorials (BT) has produced an outstanding result yet again. 

 

**Our student since her 10th std, Kashvi Khurana emerged as Maharashtra Girls Topper with an All India Rank (AIR) of 39. **

 

**As per common merit list, 12 students from BT have secured AIR in top 500, 32 of our students are in top 2000, 89 in top 5000 & a whopping 162 in top 10000. **

**These numbers are more than all the other institutes of Pune put together. **

 

We are still in the process of compiling the result. Till now, more than 303 students from BT have cleared the JEE Advanced 2024 exam and are now eligible to join the prestigious IITs. 

 

This result is in line with the past results produced by BT,which struck a double hat-trick of producing Pune Rank 1 in both JEE Main & JEE Advanced consecutively for 3 years (2022, 2021 & 2020).

 

BT has produced “Pune Rank 1” 10 times and “Maharashtra Rank 1” 5 times in the past 15 years now in JEE Advanced.

 

Like every year, we shall share the complete list on our website soon.

 

Keep showering your love and blessing on us.

 

Regards,

BT Team.

JEE Advanced 2024 result is expected to be declared on 9th June, Sunday.

records.subject: City Avenue: Maintenance
records.body_text:
Dear Allottees,

We would like to inform you that the Promoter i.e. Carnation Landmarks LLP has collected provisional maintenance charges for the initial period of 24 months on behalf of City Avenue Housing Society Limited ("Society") from the apartment holders of residential Building 'N' and commercial Building 'M' at the time of handing over possession to the respective apartment holders. The maintenance in respect of the Building 'N' has commenced from 1st Jan 2020 and for Building 'M' from 1st July 2020.

Kindly note that from the date of commencement of the maintenance, the onus of maintaining the buildings/project premises is that of the Society/Committee members. You are well aware that the handover to the Society at the First General Body Meeting conducted on 15th February 2020 could not be completed due to certain uncertainties and hence the aforesaid collected provisional maintenance was not handed over to the Society. As a result whereof, the Promoter continued to bear the expenses towards the maintenance of the Project premises which is not its obligation.

In view of the foregoing, we hereby inform you all that, at the time of handover, the expenses incurred towards maintenance shall be deducted from the collected provisional maintenance amounts and the balance will be handed over to the Society/Committee members of the Society alongwith an audited statement justifying the incurred expenses.

Kindly take a note of the same.



Thanks & Regards,
Javed Ali Sayyed

records.subject: City Avenue: Maintenance
records.body_text:
Dear Allottees,

We would like to inform you that the Promoter i.e. Carnation Landmarks LLP has collected provisional maintenance charges for the initial period of 24 months on behalf of City Avenue Housing Society Limited ("Society") from the apartment holders of residential Building 'N' and commercial Building 'M' at the time of handing over possession to the respective apartment holders. The maintenance in respect of the Building 'N' has commenced from 1st Jan 2020 and for Building 'M' from 1st July 2020.

Kindly note that from the date of commencement of the maintenance, the onus of maintaining the buildings/project premises is that of the Society/Committee members. You are well aware that the handover to the Society at the First General Body Meeting conducted on 15th February 2020 could not be completed due to certain uncertainties and hence the aforesaid collected provisional maintenance was not handed over to the Society. As a result whereof, the Promoter continued to bear the expenses towards the maintenance of the Project premises which is not its obligation.

In view of the foregoing, we hereby inform you all that, at the time of handover, the expenses incurred towards maintenance shall be deducted from the collected provisional maintenance amounts and the balance will be handed over to the Society/Committee members of the Society alongwith an audited statement justifying the incurred expenses.

Kindly take a note of the same.



Thanks & Regards,
Javed Ali Sayyed
CRM-Department
KPDL.Pune

records.body_text:
Dear Alumni,

Greetings from *V.R. Siddhartha Engineering College & VRSEC Alumni
Association(VRSECOSA).*

You are aware that we have constituted an award for prominent Alumni of our
college as “Distinguished Alumni”. This award would be given to the
selected alumnus for the success in their career and life and their
contribution to society.

  We request the alumni to send an application nominating yourself or any
alumni of VRSEC whom you think is worthy to this award. A committee would
finalize the name of the person. The award will be given in the month of
December 2019 during our Annual meet. Please spare a minute and send an
application with the name, address, present occupation and the
contributions and achievements for the nomination to
alumni@vrsiddhartha.ac.in.

Proforma  for nomination and reciprocate by Principal of the
college-Dr.A.V.Ratna Prasad is attached.
